name: branding-navy-brand-tiles-rounded-portraits-and-copy-cards
title: Navy Brand Tiles with Portraits and Copy Cards
whatItIs: A pale board with a large navy panel holding a white card with a woman showing her phone and card and an 'Explore Payno' button, and four rounded tiles alternating navy copy cards ('Spend money with control.', 'Move money when you need it.') and photos with headlines.
whatItMeans: Alternating solid navy copy tiles and warm photos create rhythm, and identical corner radii unify them.
techniques: Alternate copy tiles and photo tiles
Large navy panel framing an inner card
Short headlines in sans with tight leading
Pill logo lockup and URL in each tile corner
Warm candid photography against cool navy

vocabulary.definition: A tile containing only a headline and brand marks.
A tile with a photograph and overlaid headline.
A card nested within a larger coloured panel.
